## Synthesis by Domain

### Governance and Institutions

Governance synthesis now includes youth platform policy, electoral legitimacy, institutional capacity, public symbols, regulation, infrastructure, political-theory method, and boundary-setting. ### Psychology and Personal Development

Psychology synthesis emphasizes embodied regulation, relational safety, calibrated action, intimacy boundaries, and limits on self-interpretation. The common thread is that insight is useful only when it restores present contact, agency, and trustworthy feedback.

- [[OverintellectualizedRelationshipAnalysis]] shows that psychological knowledge can become a self-surveillance tool when it is used to explain every feeling logically instead of reconnecting the person with present safety, affect, and embodied trust. Work, education, and society synthesis focuses on routines, incentives, trust, care, creator labor, travel, public education, and institutional labels. Recent sources show that formal status matters less than actual labor arrangements, safety boundaries, and judgment in practice.

- Learning sources treat durable skill as active work: [[SelfTestingMemoryPractice]], [[DesirableDifficulty]], [[SelfDirectedLearning]], and [[LearningExperienceDesign]] preserve recall, reasoning, curiosity, and correction rather than treating fluent answers as enough.
